references.text: Gideon and his 300 men pursue the Midianites, which is the context for his return from war
Gideon struck the Midianite camp and captured the two kings Zebah and Zalmunna, leading to his victorious return
Gideon is introduced as the son of Joash, the same familial designation used here
Jerubbaal, son of Joash, returned to his home after the war - parallel to this verse
Joshua fought against the Amorites near Beth-Horon, another example of a victorious return from war
